headline: Lyon Gear Hit by Cyber Raid; Says Operations Unaffected
body: LGS, a key player in the European automotive supply chain, reported a cyber intrusion where internal files were allegedly exfiltrated. The company acknowledged the breach, affecting IT systems but assured stakeholders that manufacturing at their French plant continues without interruption. Deliveries to clients remain unaffected as well. No further details on the nature of the attack have been disclosed.
